After her relationship with American singer Justin Timberlake ended in 2002, she made friends with her backing vocalist Annet Artani. "Annet Artani"
Annet Artani Annet Artani (""Αννέτ Αρτάνη"" in Greek), born 6 September 1976, is a Greek American singer and songwriter. results.contents:
"New Faces of 1952"
